tracks.title: Preparing a classroom poster

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 明日の発表の準備をしましょう。まず、何をしますか。
turns.english: Let's prepare for tomorrow's presentation. What shall we do first?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: まず、紙を取って、名前を書きます。
turns.english: First, we take paper and write our names.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: そのあと、どうしますか。
turns.english: What do we do after that?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 写真を見てから、ポスターを作ります。
turns.english: After looking at the photos, we make a poster.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: ポスターを作ってから、先生に見せてください。
turns.english: After making the poster, please show it to the teacher.

comprehensionPrompts: What do they write on the paper?
What happens before making the poster?

tracks.title: Making lunch together

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 今日のお昼ご飯は、どうやって作りますか。
turns.english: How will we make today's lunch?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 野菜を洗って、切ります。
turns.english: We wash the vegetables and cut them.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 野菜を切ってから、何をしますか。
turns.english: After cutting the vegetables, what do we do?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 鍋に入れて、少し煮ます。
turns.english: We put them in a pot and simmer them a little.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: 食べる前に、何をしますか。
turns.english: What do we do before eating?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 手を洗ってから、みんなで食べましょう。
turns.english: After washing our hands, let's eat together.

comprehensionPrompts: What happens after placing them in the pot?
What do they do before eating?
